posts.name: Envisioner

McBehrer:

An empty set has 0, so is technically correct.

It was my question, and I say that absence of any value is not the same as a value of 0.  This should be a familiar concept to gamers - in D&D for instance, a character who has Constitution of 0 has a modifier of -5 (and is dead, more relevantly), but one who entirely lacks a Constitution score (due to being animate but not alive) calculates their Fortitude save as if they had a Constitution modifier of 0.
